title: Lin Chong in the Snowstorm
lines: Lin Chong was the finest spear instructor of the Imperial Guard — a man of honor, a loving husband, a loyal servant. He had never offended anyone. This was precisely why he was targeted.

The Grand Marshal Gao Qiu's son had taken a fancy to Lin Chong's wife. He had Lin Chong framed for conspiracy, stripped of his rank, branded on the face, and exiled to a distant penal colony. Still, Lin Chong endured, hoping for eventual justice.

In the Cangzhou Prison Camp, Lin Chong was assigned to tend the fodder depot — a remote building deep in the snowy wilderness. One freezing night, he went out to buy wine. When he returned, he found the depot ablaze.

Hiding in a nearby temple, Lin Chong overheard the soldiers sent to kill him congratulating themselves: 'Once the fire burns out, we'll collect his bones and report the accident.' In that moment, the last ember of his loyalty to the state turned to ash.
He killed them all. Then, carrying only his spear, he walked into the blizzard toward Liangshan, a righteous hero turned outlaw by a world that had no room for righteous heroes.
